headline: Revenue and margins grow while buybacks erase book equity
summary_short: Revenue rose to $1,298.0M, up 6.6% y/y, as operating income grew 28.5% y/y to $342.5M and diluted EPS reached $1.83, up 29.8% y/y. GoDaddy also narrowed full-year revenue guidance and reaffirmed its NEBITDA-margin and free-cash-flow targets.
summary_long: Revenue grew 6.6% y/y to $1,298.0M (6.3% constant-currency), led by 11.0% growth in Applications & Commerce versus 3.9% in Core Platform. Operating margin expanded to 26.4% (+450bp y/y) on operating income of $342.5M, up 28.5% y/y; net income rose 20.1% y/y to $240.1M. NEBITDA reached $434.1M, up 13.7% y/y (33.4% margin), and free cash flow was $443.5M, up 13.3% y/y. GoDaddy repurchased $824.4M of stock in H1. For Q3 2026 it guided revenue to $1.315B-$1.335B and NEBITDA margin to approximately 33%; full-year revenue guidance was narrowed to $5.215B-$5.255B, with the >33% NEBITDA-margin and ~$1.8B free-cash-flow targets reaffirmed. Cash was $1,155.5M; long-term debt $3,759.4M; equity fell to $6.7M on buybacks.

drivers.explanation: CEO cited an AI transformation centered on Airo and an 'agentic operating system' for customers; CFO cited disciplined execution, expanded profitability, and strong free cash flow funding substantial buybacks.
Growth was led by Applications & Commerce revenue (+11.0% y/y) on continued Airo momentum, alongside Core Platform growth of +3.9% y/y and international revenue up 7.9% y/y.
Margin leverage: total revenue rose 6.6% y/y while total costs and operating expenses rose only 0.4% y/y, including a $17.3M y/y drop in depreciation and amortization.
Net income growth (+20.1% y/y) trailed operating income growth (+28.5% y/y) because the income-tax provision nearly doubled to $76.9M from $39.2M a year ago.
Equity fell toward zero as the company repurchased 9.8 million shares for $851.8M year-to-date through July 29, 2026, widening the accumulated deficit faster than retained earnings grew.
